title: An Algebraic Framework for Data Systems: Classification and Optimization of Algebraic Structures for Data Organization and Coding
summary: Modern data systems are commonly studied through computational and information-theoretic methods, while their algebraic properties remain largely unexplored. This paper introduces a mathematical framework for modelling data systems using algebraic codes over finite groups, organized by an \emph{axiom signature}: each algebraic axiom of the data domain is shown to be \emph{sufficient} for a specific coding-theoretic capability, and each implication is given its precise reading (MDS parameters do not require a field; quotients require normality, not commutativity).
